tasks.title: Black-box non-reversible PDMP (Boomerang / Zig-Zag / BPS) with exact invariance
tasks.goal: Implement and benchmark a black-box PDMP (Boomerang elliptical flow around a learned Gaussian reference or automatic-thinning / Metropolis-adjusted Zig-Zag/BPS) using declared aux_spec, passing Tier 0/1 global-balance invariance at dims=(6,20) and real Stan posteriors.
bottlenecks: cost per effective sample vs HMC

tasks.title: Crack eight_schools_centered & pilots funnels without harming Gaussian ESS/cost
tasks.goal: Evolve multiscale transition dynamics (reversible WALNUTS micro-step halving, DRGHMC, or adaptive-refresh GHMC+Barker) that pass eight_schools_centered (R-hat < 1.01, zero bias) while keeping >= 0.9x a1_diag ESS/cost on blr/gp_regr/garch11.
bottlenecks: avoiding Barker cost drag on easy Gaussians

tasks.title: Unify Fisher low-rank preconditioning with heavy-tail MAD/score robustness & fast warmup
tasks.goal: Combine robust diagonal scaling (MAD / Fisher score-variance) with low-rank correlation adaptation that beats a1_diag on all 4 passing Stan models AND improves dim=20 StudentT(nu=1.5) and banana without triggering funnel bias on eight_schools_centered.

tasks.title: Higher-order symplectic splitting + persistent-momentum GHMC / dynamic trajectory (MAMS/ChEES)
tasks.goal: Test McLachlan/BCSS splitting, persistent-momentum GHMC, MAMS (unit_sphere aux_spec), and ChEES/NUTS-style trajectory adaptation across dims=(6,20) and 5 public Stan models.

tasks.title: Ground-up MCMC sampler from scratch (no priors) passing >= 4/5 public Stan models
tasks.goal: Starting from the 43-line isotropic RWM stub in Lane A0, evolve a gradient-capable sampler from first principles that beats diagonal HMC across dims=(6,20) and passes >= 4/5 public Stan posteriors.
bottlenecks: scaling past d=6 where RWM collapses
